title: Check a path number
summary: FastAPI: Check a path number. Try /double/cat and inspect 422.
introduction: The n: int type lets FastAPI parse and check a route input. Open GET /double/4.
learningObjectives: Check a path number with FastAPI

blocks.text: Install fastapi and uvicorn with python -m pip install fastapi uvicorn. Save one example as app.py and run uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000. Use the stated route on that address.

blocks.title: Check a path number

blocks.text: The path input is checked as int before the function runs. Four is doubled to eight.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Invalid input is rejected before the function body runs.
